policy.text: Refund policy: refund the full order amount if and only if the issue is one of [damaged, not_delivered, wrong_item], the order is at most 30 days old, and the amount is at most $150. Otherwise do not refund. Use lookup(customer) to see the order.

args.body: I apologize for the inconvenience. As the order is damaged and within the 30-day refund window, I will issue a full refund for order O1337.

Hi Gus, I apologize for the wrong item in your order O1324. I'm refunding the full amount of $50 for this order as it's under our 30-day policy and the item is incorrect. Let me know if you need further assistance.

Hi Kemi, I'm very sorry for the delay. Unfortunately, refunds are only issued for damaged, undelivered, or incorrect items within 30 days for orders under $150. Your order is $86 after 16 days, so we can't process a refund at this time. Please let us know if there's anything else we can do for you.

Hi Mira, I'm sorry to hear about the damaged item in your order O1337. I'm issuing a full refund as per our policy since the issue is 'damaged', the order is under 30 days old, and the amount is within our $150 limit. Your refund is being processed.
I'm sorry to hear about the damage to your order. I'll arrange a full refund for you.

Hi Gus, I'm sorry to hear about the wrong item in your order O1324. I'm issuing a refund for the full $142 amount as the issue is a wrong_item and the order is within the 30-day policy. Let me know if you need any further assistance.
Hi Mr. Yilmaz, I'm sorry to hear about the wrong item in your order O8534. I'm issuing a refund for the full $98 amount as per our policy. Please let me know if you have any further questions!
